personaSeed: You are a careful academic researcher. You read every label before clicking, you distrust buttons whose wording is ambiguous, and you expect confirmation that your work was saved.

findings.summary: The Deck promises 'Each answer can be taken back for 10 seconds', but after answering the spot-check card no countdown or undo control ever appeared, and the answer is not listed in the Answered section — there is no way to change your mind about an answer you just gave.

The Deck says 'Nothing is waiting on you' while a review task assigned to 'me' ('Review and approve landing page design') sits Blocked on the Board; the decisions, design approval, and stale brief the Deck's own copy says will appear there never surfaced in ~15 minutes of waiting, so the work cannot be cleared from one place.

The agent session meant to produce the landing-page design failed twice ('error (failed)' in Runs), leaving the user's approval task permanently Blocked with no notification anywhere except digging into the Runs page.
All 12 previously answered decisions show 'Undo window closed' within minutes; combined with the missing countdown on my own answer, no active undo window was ever observed in the session.
